title: Constraints not carried into v3 and the minimal set that remains
decision:
Removed with the v2 runtime and NOT re-implemented:

| Constraint | Reason |
|:--|:--|
| `plan_weight` read budget, canon weight cap, token calibration/probes, read-limit | measures Markdown read paths that no longer exist; the context pack is built by code; size is reported, not gated |
| bundle digests, byte-fresh generated state, design fingerprint seal, mandatory finish + design audit gate | JSON + API removes hand-edit drift; seals created self-invalidation loops |
| route evidence from provider session logs, exact-invocation matching | caused `ROUTE_LAUNCH_MISMATCH` mid-batch; replaced by self-declared actor checked against the model pool |
| batch receipts (`BATCH_REQUIRED/AMBIGUOUS/STALE`) | batches are recommendations; `start` checks dependencies directly |
| evidence graph, self-invalidating anchors, write-site `pre_mutation`/`pre_final` | bookkeeping proofs without a measured defect they prevent at proportionate cost |
| terminal admission lease and Stop hook, delivery receipts, byte-exact final fragment | a final message cannot corrupt plan state; `next()` is computed from JSON |
| repair-decision, block-candidate, audit-admission consent, producer readiness, phase re-entry, repeat admission, fix-branch | replaced by `blocked` + `escalation`, `reopen --reason`, and owner decisions |
| continuity reducer / context taxonomy (`continue-root`, `cold-start-root` reasons) | the handoff names one Next; session choice is the owner's |
| journal migration contract, downstream gate, citation verifier, cross-plan file intersections | no consumer in the v3 flow |
| mandatory dossier quartet per phase | supporting files are optional and listed in `phase.supporting` |

Retained, simplified:

| Constraint | v3 form |
|:--|:--|
| minimum model class/effort | `start --actor` checked against `command-routing.json` model pool; undershoot refuses, unknown warns |
| owner authority | `authority.kind=owner_gate` + `gate_granted` log event (`plan.py grant`) |
| acceptance before `done` | acceptance checks recorded with exit 0 in `finish` |
| dependency order | `depends_on` + phase deps in `next()`/`start()` |
| statuses, Short IDs, qualified references, review opt-in | unchanged semantics |
| plan integrity | `plan.py check` (schema, refs, cycles, completeness, fresh views) |
rationale: Each removed rule fails the philosophy's decision test: either no measured failure, or the enforcement cost (wall time, tokens, loops) exceeded the damage it prevents, or the failure class disappears once JSON is written only by the API. Retained rules protect authority, acceptance and ordering at one cheap point.
consequences: P3.2 deletes the modules, scripts, configs, tests and docs that implement removed constraints.
Any later wish to restore one of them needs a new decision naming the measured failure (philosophy).

evidence.note: decision test: measured failure, cheapest enforcement, bounded recovery
